Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and the same as G4490; unsaid, i.e. (by implication) inexpressible:--unspeakable.
BiblicalUsage: Unspeakable is used once, for the words Paul heard when he was caught up into paradise. He heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter, and he came back unable to tell them.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for words that cannot be spoken carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the silence, that some of what God shows His people stays unspoken, and the telling of it is not given to us.
